name: visibility-movement
fault_schedule: Real filesystem cursor release control, wrong token and missing release deadline. Runtime movement itself is not executed by this component proof.
assertions: First-page barrier cannot resume until exact controller token; missing release is bounded.
Only declared page-size1,7,100 check overrides are admitted; seed/mutate remain all-size.
Exactly four seed workers are admitted for the four fixed partitions; records serialize within each partition.
Seed peer failures join admitted writes and preserve acknowledged counts without partial success.
limitations: No live stack execution in component control.
Runtime scenario must execute separately against real S3 emulator owners.
